thatmakessense.config.title: That Makes Sense
thatmakessense.config.noCropTrample.enab: When on, farmland never reverts to dirt when players, mobs, or projectiles land on it. Fall damage still applies.
thatmakessense.config.silkTouchBudding.e: When on, mining a budding amethyst block with a Silk Touch tool drops the block, making amethyst geodes renewable.
